sn42.10:2.7: “Here, venerable sir, while the king’s retinue was sitting together in the royal compound, this discussion came up among them:
sn42.10:2.8: ‘Gold and currency are proper for ascetics who follow the Sakyan. They accept and receive gold and currency.’
sn42.10:2.9: When that was said, venerable sir, I said this to that assembly:
sn42.10:2.11: ‘Gold and currency are not proper for ascetics who follow the Sakyan. They neither accept nor receive gold and currency. They have set aside gems and gold, and quit using gold and currency.’
sn42.10:2.12: I was able, venerable sir, to persuade that assembly.
